mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, body, reference_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{body}, #{referenceId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, title, body, reference_id, is_read, created_at FROM notifications ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE type = #{type}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
